en.content: Numbers are to be formed between 1000 and 3000 , which are divisible by 4 , using the digits and 6 without repetition of digits. Then the total number of such numbers is ____________.
en.explanation:
Here 1st digit is 1 or 2 only

Case-I

If first digit is 1

Then last two digits can be 24, 32, 36, 52, 56, 64


Case – II

If first digit is 2 then last two digit can be 16, 36, 56, 64


Total ways = 12 + 18 = 30 ways
